theorem_title: The fixed hybrid program solves the formal 3SUM task
theorem_formal_statement: theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightThreeSumHybrid.solves (κ : ℕ) : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Solves _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.s3Task (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightThreeSumHybrid.program κ) 542 (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightThreeSumHybrid.time κ) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightThreeSumHybrid.need κ) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
For every natural input-value exponent $\kappa$, the explicit hybrid program, at entry procedure 542, solves the formal integer 3SUM task with its declared time function and resource-need function. The solver predicate includes the task precondition, exact answer relation, bounded execution, and required memory preservation.

This task-level solver interface is the input needed by the compiler and benchmark wrapper to obtain a word-RAM algorithm.
